title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 16: A Mirror

scenes.say: Group therapy. A circle of vets. Pain visible.
scenes.visual: a circle of chairs with veterans in a community room, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We all wore the uniform. But none of us got the same salute coming home.
scenes.visual: a man speaking in a circle, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A vet pats him on the back. Preach that, Jersey.
scenes.visual: a hand on a shoulder in a support group, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The park. Ali plays catch with his nephew. Laughs. Real and full.
scenes.visual: a man and a small boy playing catch in a park, afternoon sun, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Healing ain't a straight line. But moments like this? They matter.
scenes.visual: a ball in the air against a bright sky, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Newark streets. A dealer nods at him. Ali ignores it.
scenes.visual: a man in a hoodie walking past a corner at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A kid watches. You was in the Army, right? That's crazy. You from here and made it out.
scenes.visual: a teenage boy watching from across a street, streetlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text
a man stopping on a sidewalk under a streetlight, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Maybe I ain't a hero. But maybe I could be a mirror for the next kid.
scenes.visual: a reflection of a city street in a shop window at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Seventeen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a Newark skyline at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 16 of 25: A Mirror. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
